Subnet Mask: 255.255.255.0
Default Gateway: 192.168.1.1
Questions
Compare the TCP/IP configuration of this computer to others on the
LAN
Some similarities I noticed are the similar first 3 octets in the Ipv4 address, same subnet
mask, and same default gateway.

What is similar about the IP addresses? The first 3 octets are similar to both devices. What is similar about the default gateways? They are exactly the same. The IP addresses should share the same network portion.

All machines
in the LAN should share the same default gateway. Record a couple of
the IP Addresses:
192.168.1.3
192.168.1.4
192.168.1.6
192.168.1.13

Conclusion and Takeaways
Basic network information can be seen by the input of ipconfig, and additional
information through ipconfig /all. You can verify connections by pinging other
hosts thru the command ping. You can trace the route going to the host by the
command tracert. I had learned a lot from the lab activity as it covered some of
the basic commands you can issue for networking.

Although basic commands,
they are used almost everytime as an IT so learning them is very important.
